messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need the final benchmark narrative for next week
elaine: Focus: latency vs cost slices + 3 chart hooks for the blog + a 30s webinar opener. Who can own charts + copy?
michael: I can own charts. Need the raw run outputs (p95, tokens/sec, cost-per-token) and the scenario slices (small prompt, long context, heavy batching).
tara: I'll draft 3 headline lines (short, mid, long) and alt CTAs. Tone: engineering-first, not marketing hyperbole. Example: 'Same model. 3x lower cost at production latency.'
jordan: For webinar reg routing — if someone downloads the benchmark whitepaper, route to SDR queue A. If they request dedicated capacity, route to AE tier. Can we map CTAs to routing?
vince: +1 on mapping. Also need a canonical chart sizing spec for creative. I'll make a Figma frame at 1200x630 and a slide master.
ops-bot: dataset export ready: https://redwood.s3/bench/2026-03-run-42.csv (permission: marketing-read)
michael: grabbing that link now. Q: do we plot 'latency per req' or 'p95/median' on the x-axis? My vote: p95 latency ticks, and cost per 1M tokens as secondary axis.
tara: p95 + cost is clear. For audience segments, highlight 'interactive apps' vs 'batch embedding' lanes.
elaine: Can copy drafts be by EOD? Also need 3 tweet-sized lines and a 30s webinar opener. Post options below.
tara: Draft ledes: A) 'Predictable latency beats raw throughput.' B) 'Same model. 3x lower cost at production latency.' C) 'Optimize the serving path — win on latency and unit economics.'
michael: Chart spec proposal:
```
- X: p95 latency (ms)
- Y left: throughput (tokens/sec)
- Y right: estimated cost per 1M tokens ($)
- Series: model variants (float32, int8 quant, cached)
```

jordan: Routing mapping draft:
```
whitepaper_download -> marketing_sdr_queue_A
request_dedicated -> AE_enterprise_queue
webinar_registrant -> nurture_sequence_2
social_clicks_high_intent -> sales_alert_Tier2
```

vince: I'll add a small checklist for handoff: figma exports, chart JSON, alt text, 3 tweet lines, 2 blog lede variants, webinar opener, routing mapping.
elaine: Owners: charts=michael, copy=tara, routing=jordan, creative=vince. Deliver by 5pm PT tomorrow. :thumbsup: :rocket:
michael: will do — I’ll post the first chart draft as PNG and Chart JSON to the thread when ready.
tara: will post copy options by EOD and pin the preferred tone.
jordan: will update the CRM routing rules after lunch and post the mapping doc.
vince: figma draft posting to #design in ~45m, will share link here.
ops-bot: reminder: benchmark CSV expires in 30 days (data-retention).
elaine: perfect — thanks team. small ask: keep all linkable assets in the marketing/bench/2026 folder so ops can ingest them into the site.
michael: noted.
tara: noted.
jordan: noted.
vince: doing that now.
elaine: closing — sync if blockers.
